scope: Six repeatedly viewed development requests, three parents. All assisted combinations remain separate; no selected-best method or automatic-success claim.

definitions.primary_average: First mean of valid noises within each parent, then equal mean across parents. Every valid count is recorded.
definitions.I: ConflictCov_C main comparison uses request intersection with I_status PASS and finite value for all six labels, separately per stage. Original unfiltered177 fields remain untouched.
definitions.area: RAW-reference mass tracks retained original slots. Actual output area can change under D0/GEO and includes separately reported bridges. These quantities are not interchangeable.
definitions.connectivity: Shared original RAW slot/corner ledger only; negative-ID bridges excluded from correspondence, included in full177 scorers.
definitions.region: Frozen assisted support regions, not automatic masks or clean-source target labels.
definitions.boundary: Cached gaps for mixed clusters containing D0 still include RAW-to-C member comparisons. C may dominate maximum gap and all-member noncoincidence. No pure RAW-to-D0 or final crack interpretation.
